# Gravix Horizon 2 — Specification Index

**88 specifications** across Phases 7-15, totalling **364 person-days** (~73 person-weeks).

Each spec is a self-contained work order. The implementing agent reads exactly one
spec plus the files it names in §4 — not the roadmap, not the charter, not the issue
thread. A spec that cannot be executed from its own contents is defective and returns
to `senior-engineering-lead` as a `SPEC DEFECT`; the implementer never improvises.

## Readiness

All specs pass the 12-check Spec Readiness Gate (`../11-agent-loops.md` §L2) and are dispatchable.

## Dispatch brief

```
Goal: <the spec's §1 objective, one sentence>
Role: <the spec's Implementer role>
Spec: docs/oss/specs/GRVX-<nnn>-<slug>.md
Read only: the spec, and the files it names in §4
Exit Criteria: every §7 acceptance criterion passes; §8 output pasted verbatim
```

Never attach conversation history. See `../11-agent-loops.md` §L3 for why: a
subagent needing more than a brief and a file list is reporting a spec defect,
whether or not it says so.
